tiers.criteria: Indexed in Scopus or Web of Science, ranked Q1 or Q2 in its best category, with stated peer review.
Indexed in Scopus or Web of Science, ranked Q3 or Q4 (or not yet ranked), with stated peer review.
Not indexed, but run by an NLU or established institution, with stated blind peer review.
Institutional or student-edited, but peer review not stated as blind, or a new journal with no track record.
No stated peer review, pay-to-publish with rapid acceptance, or other predatory indicators.
SSRN, arXiv, working papers and other unreviewed postings.
